rationale: Price is sitting at 2.2% of today's range (essentially at the session low of $42.32) with the last 5 candles showing a very tight, indecisive chop between $42.32–$42.47 — no clear directional momentum in either direction. The stock has already gapped down 3.33% and sold off further intraday, but with ATR of only $0.19 on 5m bars and price hugging the low, risk/reward for a short is poor (little room before a bounce) and a long lacks any confirmation of reversal. Given today's already realized loss and the broad market weakness (SPY -1.36%, VIXY +4.18%), the evidence does not provide sufficient edge to justify a position.
